{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Strip commas from revenue and convert to float
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Remove QA orders with revenue 999999.99
df = df[df['revenue'] != 999999.99]

# Remove refunded orders (they are not revenue)
df = df[df['status'] == 'completed']

# Remove rows where customer_age == -1 (sentinel for missing)
df = df[df['customer_age'] != -1]

# Compute conversion rate within each customer_segment, by channel
df_segmented = df.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment'])['converted'].mean().reset_index()
df_segmented['converted_rate'] = df_segmented['converted'] * 100

df_segmented

# Now extract the specific values for loyal, new, returning for both channels, and compute differences
email_loyal = df_segmented.loc[(df_segmented['channel'] == 'email') & (df_segmented['customer_segment'] == 'loyal'), 'converted_rate'].values[0]
paid_search_loyal = df_segmented.loc[(df_segmented['channel'] == 'paid_search') & (df_segmented['customer_segment'] == 'loyal'), 'converted_rate'].values[0]
diff_loyal = email_loyal - paid_search_loyal

email_new = df_segmented.loc[(df_segmented['channel'] == 'email') & (df_segmented['customer_segment'] == 'new'), 'converted_rate'].values[0]
paid_search_new = df_segmented.loc[(df_segmented['channel'] == 'paid_search') & (df_segmented['customer_segment'] == 'new'), 'converted_rate'].values[0]
diff_new = email_new - paid_search_new

email_returning = df_segmented.loc[(df_segmented['channel'] == 'email') & (df_segmented['customer_segment'] == 'returning'), 'converted_rate'].values[0]
paid_search_returning = df_segmented.loc[(df_segmented['channel'] == 'paid_search') & (df_segmented['customer_segment'] == 'returning'), 'converted_rate'].values[0]
diff_returning = email_returning - paid_search_returning

# Print only the numbers that will be used in evidence
print(f'Email, loyal: {email_loyal}')
print(f'Paid search, loyal: {paid_search_loyal}')
print(f'Difference, loyal: {diff_loyal}')

print(f'Email, new: {email_new}')
print(f'Paid search, new: {paid_search_new}')
print(f'Difference, new: {diff_new}')

print(f'Email, returning: {email_returning}')
print(f'Paid search, returning: {paid_search_returning}')
print(f'Difference, returning: {diff_returning}')"}
